identity_suggestions.how_to_intro: Catalog packs are separate data files. They can provide names, aliases, artwork, and supported KeyViewer targets without being bundled with EMMM.
identity_suggestions.how_to_catalog_detail: Choose a reviewed GitHub release or a local ZIP in Settings. Installing a pack does not change your mod folders, metadata, or images.
identity_suggestions.how_to_check_detail: Start a check here, from Mod Inbox preflight, or from an object action. EMMM only reads the relevant local object data.
identity_suggestions.how_to_review_detail: Suggestions remain optional. Confirm selected high-confidence matches in the classification wizard before EMMM changes metadata.
identity_suggestions.how_to_benefits_matching: Names and aliases help you find the right mods. Your images stay unchanged.
identity_suggestions.how_to_benefits_keyviewer: Find the right mods and use KeyViewer controls for supported objects. Your images stay unchanged.
